# Paddy's Dreamland

> A small creative community and personal site. Single-page app; the site is one route ("/") and is heavily JavaScript-dependent.

## Notes for AI crawlers

- The entire site is a single-page application served at `/`.
- Content (including the news section) is rendered client-side via JavaScript, so a crawler that doesn't execute JS will see an empty shell. This is expected, not an error.

## Links

- [Home](https://paddysdreamland.com/)
